customer: Lost the title to my pickup. Can I still sell it to you? Night shifts make office trips hard.
agent: Sorry about the lost title! North Carolina issues paper titles, and you can request a duplicate either by mail or at any North Carolina motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID, so mail may suit your schedule best. Duplicates take 4 to 6 weeks to arrive, and while you wait you can still get an offer and book an appointment, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers only last a limited time, so you may need a new one; see "How long is my offer good for?" for details.
